from_notes: Must contain at least 1,500 species of vascular plants (more than 0.5% of the world's total) as endemics ... Must have lost at least 70% of its original habitat
x: A hotspot must have lost at least 70% of its original habitat, not 90%, so option 3 is the incorrect statement. CI adopted Myers' approach (1989) and reassessed it from 1996, and the two criteria are 1,500 endemic vascular plants and 70% habitat loss.

x: Julius Sachs grouped plant tissues into three systems: dermal (epidermal), vascular (fundamental conducting) and fundamental (ground) tissue systems. Parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma are simple tissue types, not Sachs' tissue systems.
source: general knowledge, not checked (botany; printed key agrees)

from_notes: The concept of biodiversity hotspots was introduced by Norman Myers.

x: A vascular bundle contains xylem and phloem together. The cortex, endodermis and pith are ground-tissue regions without both conducting tissues.
source: general knowledge, not checked (botany; printed key agrees)
